title: Help watch the wallets: Building the CROPS-legible dataset
description: Walletbeat is an open source database that grades wallets based on CROPS values. Anyone in the Ethereum community can contribute data to Walletbeat to help users understand how CROPS maps to wallets. You will learn how to gather evidence using the proper references (e.g. screenshots, direct links, etc.), verify the evidence is correct, and contribute the data to our repo using an agentic workflow with a human in the loop. No coding skills required. You should leave this workshop with the confidence to begin contributing data to Walletbeat and open your first PR.
